title: Dive into new topics with immersive explorations in the Gemini app.
gist: Google added a library of interactive, layer-by-layer 'immersive explorations' to the Gemini app's student hub, with in-chat access and audio narration coming soon. It launches in six languages, with other languages getting an English-only experience for now.

insights.claim: The Gemini app now offers a library of immersive explorations, interactive visual scenes that let users explore topics layer-by-layer from microscopic systems to deep space, accessed via the Gemini student hub.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Targeting students with rich interactive content is a bid to win habitual usage early in the edtech segment.
insights.quote: The Gemini app now has a library of immersive explorations, giving you an interactive, visual way to explore topics layer-by-layer, from microscopic systems to deep space and more.

insights.claim: Google plans to make Gemini's immersive explorations accessible directly inside chat conversations and to add audio narration, moving them from a separate hub into the core assistant experience.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Embedding generative interactive visuals in chat pushes assistants beyond text answers, raising the bar for rival chatbots.
insights.quote: Immersive explorations will soon include audio narration to walk you through each layer.

insights.claim: Gemini's immersive explorations launched in English, Indonesian, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, French and simplified Chinese, with all other languages receiving an English-only experience for now.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: The language mix prioritizes large emerging student populations (Indonesia, India, Brazil), signaling where Google sees education-led growth.
insights.quote: This feature is available to all users in English, Indonesian, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, French, and simplified Chinese.
